sentences.en: Tinfoil hats were invented by the CIA to discredit conspiracy theorists.
sentences.zh: 铝箔帽是中情局发明的，用来质疑阴谋论者。

sentences.en: I am the victim of a widespread conspiracy meant to discredit me.
sentences.zh: 我是被广泛策划的阴谋所针对的对象，目的是让我蒙羞。

sentences.en: We are the victims of a widespread conspiracy meant to discredit us.
sentences.zh: 我们是被广泛策划的阴谋所针对的对象，目的是让我们蒙羞。
